note: A profile is explicit dataset configuration: it states what a known CSV layout's columns mean and their units. A file is matched only when ALL signature headers are present. A column whose unit is null is deliberately unresolved: add the documented unit here once it is known. Never add a unit that is not documented for the dataset.

profiles.description: Flight-controller log with t_ms / phi_deg / theta_deg / ax..gz columns
profiles.documentation_status: Column names and the time/angle units come from the project owner's description of this format. Accelerometer and gyro units are NOT documented yet; yaw and desired attitude are not part of the described columns.
